summary.en: Group a student record, initialize its members, and distinguish whole-record copies from member updates.
summary.bn: স্টুডেন্টের ডেটা এক স্ট্রাকচারে রাখো, মেম্বারে মান বসাও আর পুরো রেকর্ড কপি করতে শেখো।

notes: These complete programs target C17; declarations in loops require C99 or later.

sections.title: Initialize members and then read them
A structure and an array answer different questions

examples.title: Copy a record with an embedded name
examples.explanationHtml: The original remains Alpha 65 while the copy becomes Olpha 90.

examples.title: Omit fields in a designated initializer
examples.explanationHtml: The omitted mark is zero, the name begins with a null character, and a later update stores 75.

practice.title: Classify one student
practice.statementHtml: Read roll from 1 to 999 and mark from 0 to 100. Print Roll and mark: then roll and pass if mark is at least 40, otherwise fail. Store both in a structure.
hints: Select fields with the dot operator.

practice.title: Copy before adding a bonus
practice.statementHtml: Read mark from 0 to 100 and bonus from 0 to 20. Print Mark and bonus: then original mark and the copied record's capped mark, separated by a space. Cap the copy at 100.
hints: Modify the copy without changing the original.

practice.title: Keep omitted members initialized
practice.statementHtml: Read roll from 1 to 999 into a record initialized with {0}. Print Roll: then roll and its still-zero mark separated by a space.

practice.title: Choose a record with a tie rule
practice.statementHtml: Read rollA markA rollB markB. Rolls are 1 to 999 and marks 0 to 100. Print Two rolls and marks: then the higher-mark record's roll and mark. On equal marks choose the smaller roll.
hints: Choose and copy an entire record.

quiz.prompt: What does a struct definition create before any variable declaration?
quiz.explanation: The definition describes members; a later declaration creates an object.

quiz.prompt: Which expression selects mark from struct Student student?
quiz.explanation: Dot selects a member of an actual structure object.
Designated initializers name aggregate members from C99 onward.

quiz.prompt: What happens to an embedded char array during structure assignment?
quiz.explanation: Embedded arrays are included in whole-structure copying.
options: Its characters are copied into the destination record

quiz.prompt: Which operation is invalid for two ordinary C17 structures a and b?
quiz.explanation: C17 has structure assignment but no whole-structure equality operator.

quiz.prompt: How are omitted members of {.roll=23} initialized?
quiz.explanation: An aggregate initializer gives defined initialization to omitted members.
options: They are absent from the object

quiz.prompt: Why can sizeof a structure exceed the sum of member sizes?
quiz.explanation: Padding supports member and array-element alignment.
options: Strings always add an extra array

quiz.prompt: Which named student fields print after designated initialization?
quiz.explanation: The initializer sets roll 17, name Learner, and mark 82.

quiz.prompt: Which name and mark remain in the original after copying a structure?
quiz.explanation: The embedded arrays and mark fields belong to separate objects.

quiz.prompt: Which omitted-field values and updated mark print?
quiz.explanation: The initializer zeros omitted members before mark receives 75.

keyPoints.en: A structure groups named members of different types.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রাকচার আলাদা টাইপের মেম্বার একসঙ্গে রাখে।

keyPoints.en: The dot operator selects a member of a structure object.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রাকচারের অবজেক্ট থেকে মেম্বার নিতে ডট ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Designated initializers name the members receiving values.
keyPoints.bn: Designated initializer-এ কোন মেম্বারে মান যাবে তা নামে লেখা থাকে।

keyPoints.en: Structure assignment copies embedded arrays as well as scalar members.
keyPoints.bn: স্ট্রাকচার কপি করলে ভেতরের অ্যারের মানও কপি হয়।

keyPoints.en: Compare meaningful members rather than whole structures with ==.
keyPoints.bn: পুরো স্ট্রাকচারে == না দিয়ে দরকারি মেম্বারগুলো তুলনা করো।

examQuestions.question: Distinguish a struct tag, a structure definition, and a structure object.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Student is the tag. struct Student { ... }; defines the member layout. struct Student student; creates an object of that type. The object owns its actual member storage.

examQuestions.question: Explain structure copying for a record containing an embedded name array.
examQuestions.answerHtml: A whole-structure assignment copies its member values, including the embedded array characters. The destination record then owns its own embedded name. Editing the destination array leaves the source unchanged. A pointer member would instead copy an address, so that would require separate ownership reasoning.

Alpha 65 | Olpha 90

The second object receives a member-wise value copy and is then changed independently.
